Undisputed class runner of the race dropping from Group 1 company (6th beaten 0.4L in The Galaxy, 2nd in G1 Oakleigh Plate carrying 59.0kg). Resumes here off two sharp trial wins, handles rain-affected ground, and stalks midfield (canonical style P) with huge late sectionals despite top weight.

Pure 1000m specialist (19: 6-5-4 at trip) who will seize the early lead (canonical style E) under Blake Shinn. Comes off a tough 3rd in Randwick Bm88 and a narrow 2nd at this track. Tough on-pacer who will give a bold sight in the mud.

Dangerous progressive 4yo mare who handed Cavalry Girl a defeat two starts ago over 1100m at Caulfield. Third-up peak cycle, gets right down in the weights at 55.0kg, and possesses a devastating turn of foot from off the pace (canonical style S).

Proven Listed winner coming off a close 5th in the Santa Ana Lane Sprint Series Final at Flemington. 1000m is sharp, but wide draw allows him to balance up and swoop down the outside (canonical style S) if the speed cooks up front.

Reliable 1000m campaigner (11: 7-1-2 at the trip) with a win at Sandown-Hillside earlier this prep. Ran 3rd behind Cavalry Girl last start; honest placegetter suited by genuine tempo (canonical style P).
